# cJSON host-test dependency

cJSON 1.7.18 is vendored here for the hardware-free RX HTTP/OTA tests.
These are the same parser sources previously read from the private ESP-IDF
installation. They do not change the firmware dependency setup.

Upstream: https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON

The original MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`. `SHA256SUMS.txt` at the
Observatory root binds these exact source files.
